title: Two-sided Hausdorff-measure comparison on a bi-Lipschitz piece (supplied (NT))
statement: Let P, n ∈ ℕ, L ∈ ℝ≥0 and m ∈ ℝ with m > 0. Let G : ℝⁿ → ℝ^P be L-Lipschitz and let A ⊆ ℝⁿ be any set with m|a − a'| ≤ |G(a) − G(a')| for all a, a' ∈ A. Then for every Z ⊆ A, in [0, ∞]: ofReal(m)ⁿ·λ(Z) ≤ Hⁿ(G(Z)) ≤ Lⁿ·λ(Z), where λ = volume on ℝⁿ and Hⁿ = μHE[n] on ℝ^P.
lean_statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (G : Euclid n → Euclid P) (A : Set (Euclid n)) (L : NNReal) (m : ℝ), LipschitzWith L G → 0 < m → (∀ a ∈ A, ∀ a' ∈ A, m * ‖a - a'‖ ≤ ‖G a - G a'‖) → ∀ Z : Set (Euclid n), Z ⊆ A → ENNReal.ofReal m ^ n * volume Z ≤ μHE[n] (G '' Z) ∧ μHE[n] (G '' Z) ≤ (L : ℝ≥0∞) ^ n * volume Z
